title: Is Kylie Jenner’s daughter Stormi planning to launch a beauty brand?
summary: Stormi Webster, the daughter of make-up mogul Kylie Jenner, could be the latest celebrity offspring to enter the beauty business with their own brand, according to a recent trademark filing
